name: Omarchy Theme
description: Makes cc-cockpit match your Omarchy desktop. Pick the theme "Omarchy" in Settings › Appearance and it follows whichever Omarchy theme is active: switch Omarchy from Tokyo Night to Catppuccin, Rose Pine or a light theme, and the app, its panels and the Claude terminals re-colour within a second, with no restart. How it works: the plugin reads the palette Omarchy writes for the active theme (~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml) and maps it onto the app's colours: background and bar shades, text, accent, borders, session status dots, tab flags. The terminal gets the same 16 colours as Omarchy's own terminal, so a Claude tab matches the terminal next to it. It only reads those files; it runs no commands and sends nothing anywhere. Without Omarchy (another desktop, or a Mac) it is a Tokyo Night theme. Needs cc-cockpit 0.15.0 or later.
author: Oleg Bronzov
